meta.title: PulseUp — Workout Tracker, Social Fitness & Coaching App
meta.description: PulseUp is a fitness app for personalized workout plans, gym and cardio tracking, live training with friends, and personal trainer program management.

hero.titleLine1: The world is training right now.

whatIsPulseUp.title: What is PulseUp?
whatIsPulseUp.intro: PulseUp is a fitness platform designed for both individuals and personal trainers.
forUsersItems: Track running, walking and cycling sessions
forCoachesItems: Manage multiple students from one dashboard

socialFitness.title: One app for training, tracking and coaching.
socialFitness.description: PulseUp combines personalized workout planning, workout tracking, cardio tracking, social fitness, gamification and coaching tools in one application.

features.title: Crew
features.description: Create or join a Crew — a small group of friends training together and keeping each other accountable.

features.title: Party Workout
features.description: Start a synchronized workout session that your whole Crew joins and completes together in real time.

features.title: Live Cardio
features.description: Track a run, walk or ride live and see your Crew's position, pace and distance on a shared map.

features.title: Feed
features.description: Post workouts, cardio sessions and achievements to a social feed your Crew and followers can see.

featureGrid.title: One fitness app, every training tool.
featureGrid.description: Personalized workout plans, cardio tracking, gamification, social training and personal trainer tools — all in a single application.

gamification.title: Track your progress with XP, levels, streaks and achievements.
gamification.description: Every completed workout earns XP toward your level. Consecutive training days build a streak, and reaching a milestone unlocks an achievement you can share with your Crew.

workoutExperience.title: Workout tracking built for real training sessions.
workoutExperience.description: Log sets, reps and weight for every exercise, follow built-in rest timers between sets, and track outdoor or indoor cardio with precise distance, pace and calorie data.

highlights.title: Personalized workout plans
highlights.description: Programs that adapt to your goals, experience and equipment — no guesswork.

highlights.title: Exercise instructions
highlights.description: Clear, guided instructions for every movement so you always train with confidence.

highlights.title: Rest timer, built in
highlights.description: Automatic rest timers between sets keep your session flowing without checking a clock.

highlights.title: Smart cardio tracking
highlights.description: Distance, pace and calories tracked precisely for outdoor and indoor cardio alike.

highlights.title: Apple Health & Health Connect
highlights.description: Heart rate, active energy and steps sync automatically with Apple Health and Health Connect.

highlights.title: Gyms near you
highlights.description: Find nearby gyms and pick where you're training next, wherever you are.

forCoaches.title: Build programs. Assign them. Track results.
forCoaches.description: PulseUp gives personal trainers a real toolkit for managing students, from a curated template library to a fully custom program builder and student dashboard.

highlights.title: Template library
highlights.description: Start from a curated catalog organized by goal, experience level and weekly frequency.

highlights.title: Full customization
highlights.description: Edit workout names, reorder exercises and adjust sets, reps and rest in a guided step-by-step builder.

highlights.title: Assign to students
highlights.description: Send a program to one student or many at once — each gets their own independent plan.

highlights.title: Defined start & end dates
highlights.description: Every assignment has a clear timeline, so you and your students always know what's next.

pulseAiChat.title: Chat with Pulse AI, your training assistant.
pulseAiChat.description: Ask about your programs, challenges, body metrics or training history — Pulse AI answers in real time, right inside the app.

highlights.title: Personalized training recommendations
highlights.description: Ask for a program or challenge that fits your goal, and Pulse AI searches PulseUp's own catalog to match you with the right one.

highlights.title: Body metrics, tracked in chat
highlights.description: Log your weight, body fat, muscle percentage and visceral fat right in the conversation — and get your basal metabolic rate calculated automatically.

highlights.title: Knows your training streak
highlights.description: Pulse AI opens conversations aware of your streak, days since your last workout, and your crew's recent activity to keep you motivated.

highlights.title: Honest about your diet plan
highlights.description: If a nutritionist has already prescribed you a plan, Pulse AI can remind you of your goals and macros — but it never guesses whether you actually followed it.

liveCardio.title: Track cardio sessions live and see your Crew's progress in real time.
liveCardio.description: Start a run, walk or ride and invite your Crew to join. See each other's position, pace and progress on a shared live map until the session ends.

workoutParty.title: Start a synchronized group workout session.
workoutParty.description: Open a Party Workout lobby, invite your Crew, and wait for everyone to mark themselves ready. Once the countdown reaches zero, the whole group starts the same workout together, and everyone who finishes earns a shared XP bonus.
steps: Players join the lobby in real time
Ready status syncs instantly across the party
A synchronized countdown starts the workout for everyone
Finishing together unlocks a shared XP bonus

feed.title: Share your training on a social feed.
feed.description: Post completed cardio sessions, workout photos, achievements and level-ups to a feed your Crew and followers can see and react to.

achievements.title: Unlock achievements as you reach training milestones.
achievements.description: PulseUp tracks milestones like workout counts, streaks and distance goals, and awards a badge each time you reach one.

items.quote: Party Workout changed how our whole group trains. We show up more because we know everyone else is waiting in the lobby.
items.name: Marina Souza

items.quote: Live Cardio made my morning runs social again. Racing my friends' pace in real time is way more motivating than a solo run.
items.name: Diego Ramos

items.quote: The streaks and XP kept me consistent for the first time in years. Seeing my Crew's achievements pushes me to keep going.
items.name: Kaique Alves

items.a: PulseUp is a fitness app for personalized workout plans, gym and cardio tracking, gamification, social training with friends, and personal trainer program management.
Open a lobby, invite your Crew, and everyone marks themselves ready. Once the countdown ends, the whole party starts the same workout together and earns a shared XP bonus for finishing as a group.
Absolutely. Every feature — personalized plans, cardio tracking, achievements — works solo. Social features like Crew, Party Workout and Live Cardio are there whenever you want them.
Start a run, walk or ride and invite your Crew to join in real time. You'll see each other's position, pace and progress on a shared live map until the session ends.

Yes. Personal trainers get a dedicated dashboard to build workout templates, customize full programs, assign them to one or more students with a defined start and end date, and track athlete progress.
Smartwatch and wearable integrations are on our roadmap. For now, PulseUp syncs with Apple Health and Health Connect and tracks your sessions precisely using your phone's GPS and sensors.
Yes. PulseUp is completely free — personalized plans, Crew, Party Workout, Live Cardio, XP, streaks and achievements are all included at no cost.

meta.title: PulseUp Coach Workspace — Coaching Tools for Personal Trainers
meta.description: Manage athletes, build programs from a real exercise database, and track every workout you assigned, right inside PulseUp.

hero.subtitle: Manage athletes, build programs from a real exercise database, and track every workout you assigned — all inside PulseUp.

whatIs.title: What is the Coach Workspace?
whatIs.intro: The Coach Workspace is PulseUp's area for personal trainers to track their roster of athletes, build training programs, and review every completed session — without leaving the app their athletes already use.
forUsersItems: Training programs on their phone, day by day
A full history of completed workouts
Fast feedback from their coach on every session
forCoachesItems: A dashboard with your coaching stats

tracking.title: See every athlete's progress in detail
tracking.description: The dashboard turns your coaching business into numbers, and each athlete's profile shows exactly where they stand in the program.

features.title: Coaching stats
features.description: Total athletes, completed workouts, active athletes, and training time, with daily, weekly, and monthly views.

features.title: Athlete profile
features.description: Level, time under your coaching, completed programs and workouts, current streak, and full history.

features.title: Session detail
features.description: See exactly what happened set by set — real weight and reps against what was prescribed, plus any cardio logged that day.

features.title: Direct messaging
features.description: Talk to the athlete in a thread that belongs to your coaching relationship, separate from personal chat.

featureGrid.title: Everything your coaching business needs
featureGrid.description: Real tools to build, assign, and track your athletes' training.

howItWorks.title: Build a program in a few steps
howItWorks.description: The creation wizard takes you from a blank slate to an assigned program, with a real exercise database at every step.

templates.title: Reuse what already works
templates.description: Every program you create becomes a template ready to reuse — and you also get a recommended catalog by goal, experience, and frequency.

highlights.title: My workouts
highlights.description: Every program you create is saved as a template — reuse it without editing a thing.

highlights.title: Recommended catalog
highlights.description: Ready-made templates by goal, experience, and frequency, ready to use as a base.

highlights.title: Full preview
highlights.description: See every workout, exercise, set, and rest period before using or assigning the template.

highlights.title: Editable anytime
highlights.description: Adjust name, exercises, order, reps, and rest before sending it to the athlete.

moments.title: See the moment your athletes finish a workout
moments.description: Whenever an athlete finishes a workout you assigned and shares a photo, it shows up in your Coaching Moments — only yours, never mixed with the app's general feed.

highlights.title: Only your coaching business
highlights.description: Shows only workouts you assigned yourself — not the general feed from other users.

highlights.title: Automatic social proof
highlights.description: Every completion becomes a moment, with no extra effort from you or the athlete.

highlights.title: Passive tracking
highlights.description: A quick way to see who's training, without opening every profile one by one.

highlights.title: Straight from the assigned workout
highlights.description: The moment comes from the actual execution of the program you built.

items.q: Do I need to be a verified personal trainer to use the Coach Workspace?
items.a: Yes. You submit your professional registration (CREF) and its issuing council; verification is reviewed before program creation is unlocked.

items.q: What happens if my verification gets suspended?
items.a: Existing athletes and programs stay active, but creating new programs is blocked until you're reactivated.

items.q: Can I edit a template from the recommended catalog before using it?
items.a: Yes. Shared catalog templates always fork into your own copy — editable in name, exercises, order, sets, and rest — before you assign it to an athlete.

items.q: Do Coaching Moments show workouts from other app users?
items.a: No. Only moments from athletes you personally assigned the workout to show up.

finalCta.title: Bring your coaching business to PulseUp
finalCta.description: Build programs, track every athlete, and review every session — all in one place.

meta.title: PulseUp Nutritionist Workspace — Meal Plans for Nutritionists
meta.description: Build meal plans with calorie and macro targets, automatic per-meal calculations, and reuse any past plan as a template.

hero.subtitle: Build plans with calorie and macro targets, automatic per-meal calculations, and reuse any past plan as a template.

whatIs.title: What is the Nutritionist Workspace?
whatIs.intro: The Nutritionist Workspace is PulseUp's area for nutritionists to build personalized meal plans, with calorie targets, macros, and measurement tracking — right from their phone.
forUsersItems: A meal plan broken down by meal, with kcal and macros calculated
Calorie and macronutrient targets set by you
Weight, body-fat %, and lean-mass % tracked across plans
forCoachesItems: A full meal plan, meal by meal
Calorie and macro targets with a live preview
Any past plan as a template for a new patient

tracking.title: See each patient's evolution
tracking.description: Every plan records weight, body-fat %, and lean-mass % at the moment it's created — the plan history becomes a patient evolution chart.

features.title: Evolution chart
features.description: Weight, body-fat percentage, and lean-mass percentage, built from the plans created over time.

features.title: Automatic calorie target
features.description: From the patient's weight, height, age, and sex, the app estimates the plan's calorie target.

features.title: Optional skin-fold measurements
features.description: Log measurements across 7 sites (triceps, subscapular, suprailiac, abdominal, chest, midaxillary, and thigh) when it makes sense.

features.title: Macros with a live preview
features.description: Set protein, carb, and fat targets and see the calculated kcal instantly.

featureGrid.title: Everything to build the right plan
featureGrid.description: Real tools to create, calculate, and reuse meal plans.

howItWorks.title: Build a plan in a few steps
howItWorks.description: The wizard takes you from patient to scheduled plan, with automatic calculations at every step.

meals.title: Every meal, calculated instantly
meals.description: Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks — build each meal from a real food database and see kcal, protein, carbs, fat, and sugar calculated automatically.

highlights.title: 6 meals a day
highlights.description: Breakfast, morning snack, lunch, afternoon snack, dinner, and evening snack.

highlights.title: Real food database
highlights.description: Pick the food and the serving size — the nutritional calculation comes ready, and it's editable.

highlights.title: Multiple options per meal
highlights.description: Offer more than one option for the same meal, giving the patient flexibility.

highlights.title: Review before scheduling
highlights.description: Compare the target with what's planned, see the macro and skin-fold summary before sending it.

templates.title: Every plan becomes a template
templates.description: No separate template library — any plan you've already created can be the starting point for the next one, reusing its meals.

highlights.title: Never start from zero
highlights.description: Pick "Use as template" on any past plan.

highlights.title: Reused meals
highlights.description: The original plan's meals come ready — just adjust what's different.

highlights.title: Patient and metrics set apart
highlights.description: Weight, height, skin folds, and schedule are always defined fresh for the new patient.

highlights.title: Your library grows on its own
highlights.description: Every plan you create expands your template options for the next appointment.

items.q: Do I need to be a verified nutritionist to use the Workspace?
items.a: Yes. You submit your professional registration (CRN) and its issuing council; verification is reviewed before plan creation is unlocked.

items.q: Does the app calculate the calorie target automatically?
items.a: Yes, based on the patient's weight, height, age, and sex — and you can adjust macro targets in the next step, with a live kcal preview.

items.q: Is there a separate diet template library?
items.a: No. Any plan you've already created can become a template for a new patient via "Use as template" — only the meals are reused, everything else is defined fresh.

items.q: Can I track a patient's evolution across plans?
items.a: Yes. Weight, body-fat percentage, and lean-mass percentage are recorded on every plan, forming an evolution history on the patient's profile.

finalCta.title: Bring your meal plans to PulseUp
finalCta.description: Build, calculate, and reuse meal plans — all in one place.
